name: Price
summary: Price with an optional old price (sale) and an extra like "per month". Amounts are formatted with Intl (en-US, euro).
use: Everywhere a product amount is shown.
avoid: Totals in an overview: use Cart summary.
anatomy: Old price (struck through, for a sale).
figmaProps: True: amount in the error color, old price visible.
reactProps: Only shown when it is higher than amount.
Hidden texts for screen readers. Defaults in DEFAULT_PRICE_LABELS.
behaviour: You can also use formatMoney(amount) on its own.
a11y: Screen readers hear "Was €99.95 Now €79.95". A strike-through alone is not enough.
content: Show "incl. VAT" if your customers are consumers and it is not mentioned anywhere else.
do: Use the same size for all prices in an overview.
dont: An old price that was never real.
